cases.public_problem: Solve min_x 0.5 ||x - (target + offset)||^2 subject to lower <= x <= upper. Return the finite constrained minimizer.
Solve min_x 0.5 ||x - (target + offset)||^2 subject to lower_i <= x_i <= upper_i for i=1,2,3. Return the finite constrained minimizer.
The objective is exactly 0.5 ||x - (target + offset)||^2 with box constraints lower_i <= x_i <= upper_i. Compute its constrained minimizer; the offset is part of the public instance.
Minimize exactly 0.5 ||x - (target + offset)||^2 under two public box constraints. If target + offset lies outside a bound, the constrained minimizer is clipped to that boundary.
For a seeded execution, solve the same public box-constrained quadratic min_x 0.5 ||x - (target + offset)||^2. Repeated calls with the same seed must return the same finite point.
